dict.string: Thermo lists your browser tabs to find duplicates, and closes a tab only when you confirm it.
macOS shows Wi-Fi network names only to apps allowed to use Location Services. Thermo uses it to name your network and nearby networks on the Connections page; it never reads where you are.
macOS shows Wi-Fi network names only to apps allowed to use Location Services. Thermo uses it to name your network and nearby networks on the Connections page; it never reads where you are.
Thermo connects and disconnects your paired Bluetooth devices when you click Connect or Disconnect on the Connections page.
Thermo records the camera only when you enable its camera layer and start an ordinary recording.
Thermo records the microphone only when you enable its microphone track and start an ordinary recording.
